display_long_description:
🚀 Calling All Space Explorers!
  
Experience an awe-inspiring journey to space with Space Explorers Ultimate Edition — a revolutionary new chapter of the acclaimed franchise by Emmy® Award-winning Felix & Paul Studios. Dive into the cosmos through this unique immersive experience, bringing you closer to space than you ever imagined.

[media]
  
🔭 Cutting-Edge Cinematic VR
  
Immerse yourself in our Emmy-winning VR experiences, including Space Explorers: The ISS Experience — the largest production ever filmed in space. Explore a huge library of breathtaking premium 8K video content. Continue your journey with the exclusive new Mission to the Moon chapter, chronicling humanity’s historic return to the Moon through the Artemis missions.

[media]

🪐 Interactive Mixed Reality
 
As you explore video content, discover and interact with gravity defying artifacts from the Earth, the Moon, and the ISS — right in your own home. Seamlessly blend the Space Explorers universe with your surroundings through Mixed Reality.
 
[media]

👐 Hands-Only Gesture Controls
  
Navigate worlds and interact naturally using our innovative gesture-based system.

[media]
  
🌌 The cosmos beckons — will you answer its call?

Optimized for Quest 3 & Quest 3S audiences.
A network connection speed of 50 Mbps is recommended for streaming 8k video.

[media]
